propositions: Bugs lacking close_class must be backfilled by structural signals only: revert of STATUS/COMMITS event → regression, plan-review BLOCK verdict → plan_defect, gate_error_v1 ERROR record → env_integration, otherwise → undetermined
Backfilled classifications are written to .rebar/backfill-close-class.ndjson with source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified, segregated from authoritative close_class values
The backfill script must skip bugs already carrying state[close_class] and idempotently skip ticket_ids already present in the artifact to prevent re-processing
gate_error_v1 detection requires raw event-file scanning of *-REVIEW_RESULT.json and *-COMPLETION_VERDICT.json (not all_review_results), checking event[data].get(schema) == gate_error_v1
Reverts of COMMENT/LINK events do not yield regression classification; only substantive reverts of STATUS or COMMITS do
is_authoritative(source) must return False for backfill_classified records to prove segregation from authoritative structural series
